item.subject: science
item.stem:
Meera's teacher places a few grains of potassium permanganate into a beaker of water. The colour slowly spreads through the water without any stirring.

Which statement correctly explains why the colour spreads and how using hotter water would change this?

options.A: The colour spreads because water particles are in constant motion, and the colour spreads faster in hotter water because the particles move faster.
options.B: The colour spreads only because the beaker is shaken, and the temperature of the water makes no difference.
options.C: The colour spreads because water particles are still, and the colour spreads more slowly in hotter water.
options.D: The colour spreads because the grains push the water aside, and hotter water stops the colour from spreading.
